_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a CHIP-8 project can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A project is one program.

slots.title: Program
slots.help: The CHIP-8 program. Its extension says which kind of CHIP-8 it is for: .ch8 (the kind is worked out from the program), .sc8 SUPER-CHIP, .xo8 XO-CHIP, .mc8 MegaChip, .ch10 CHIP-10, .c8x CHIP-8X, .c8e CHIP-8E, .hc8 a program with COSMAC VIP machine code in it, .c8tp the VIP's 64x64 mode, .c8b a file holding versions for several kinds. An Octo cartridge (.gif) and an Octo source file (.8o) are compiled when the project starts; a source file that includes other files is not supported. A .bin, .ram or .vip file is loaded into a bare COSMAC VIP with no CHIP-8. Nothing else is needed: the machines' own programs are part of Cadmium.
